name: compute-optimizer-automation
description: Automation is a feature within Amazon Web Services Compute Optimizer that enables you to apply optimization recommendations to your Amazon Web Services resources, reducing costs and improving performance.

subcommands.name: associate-accounts
subcommands.description: Associates one or more member accounts with your organization's management account, enabling centralized implementation of optimization actions across those accounts.

subcommands.name: create-automation-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a new automation rule to apply recommended actions to resources based on specified criteria.

subcommands.name: delete-automation-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing automation rule.

subcommands.name: disassociate-accounts
subcommands.description: Disassociates member accounts from your organization's management account, removing centralized automation capabilities.

subcommands.name: get-automation-event
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific automation event.

subcommands.name: get-automation-rule
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about a specific automation rule.

subcommands.name: get-enrollment-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current enrollment configuration for Compute Optimizer Automation.

subcommands.name: list-accounts
subcommands.description: Lists the accounts in your organization that are enrolled in Compute Optimizer and whether they have enabled Automation.

subcommands.name: list-automation-event-steps
subcommands.description: Lists the steps for a specific automation event.

subcommands.name: list-automation-event-summaries
subcommands.description: Provides a summary of automation events based on specified filters.

subcommands.name: list-automation-events
subcommands.description: Lists automation events based on specified filters.

subcommands.name: list-automation-rule-preview
subcommands.description: Returns a preview of the recommended actions that match your Automation rule's configuration and criteria.

subcommands.name: list-automation-rule-preview-summaries
subcommands.description: Returns a summary of the recommended actions that match your rule preview configuration and criteria.

subcommands.name: list-automation-rules
subcommands.description: Lists the automation rules that match specified filters.

subcommands.name: list-recommended-action-summaries
subcommands.description: Provides a summary of recommended actions based on specified filters.

subcommands.name: list-recommended-actions
subcommands.description: Lists the recommended actions based that match specified filters.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: rollback-automation-event
subcommands.description: Initiates a rollback for a completed automation event.

subcommands.name: start-automation-event
subcommands.description: Initiates a one-time, on-demand automation for the specified recommended action.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-automation-rule
subcommands.description: Updates an existing automation rule.

subcommands.name: update-enrollment-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates your account’s Compute Optimizer Automation enrollment configuration.
